important_limitations: The Phase16 synthetic graph generator contains rule-aligned campaign structures.
A perfect or near-perfect rule result does not prove real-world superiority.
A GNN result from these experiments does not prove real-world generalization.
The selected policy is specific to the Phase16 synthetic benchmark.
Fresh-alert_id semantic replay remains a documented limitation from Phase16C.
No locked CICIDS IDS test data are used.
recommended_next_step: If stronger GNN evidence is required, build an independent campaign-ground-truth benchmark containing correlations that are not defined directly by R1/R2/R3, then evaluate rule, GNN and hybrid without retuning the frozen rule baseline.
